info.name: Paginated ViewSet for retrieving coverages for the broker.

params.name: insured
params.description:
Filter coverages by insured.

Examples:
- `?insured=Acme Inc.` - Matches coverages with 'Acme Inc.' in insured name
- `?insured=Acme Inc., Acme Corp.` - Matches coverages with 'Acme Inc.' or 'Acme Corp.' in insured name

params.name: coverage_type
params.description:
Filter coverages by coverage type.

Examples:
- `?coverage_type=CYBER` - Matches coverages with 'CYBER' in coverage type
- `?coverage_type=CYBER, GENERAL_LIABILITY` - Matches coverages with 'CYBER' or 'GENERAL_LIABILITY' in coverage type

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter coverages by status.

Examples:
- `?status=ACTIVE` - Matches coverages with 'ACTIVE' in status
- `?status=ACTIVE, PENDING` - Matches coverages with 'ACTIVE' or 'PENDING' in status

params.name: agent
params.description:
Filter coverages by assigned team member.

Examples:
- `?agent=123` - Matches coverages where agent id 123 is assigned
- `?agent=123,456` - Matches coverages where agent id 123 or 456 is assigned

params.name: submission_type
params.description:
Filter coverages by submission type. Supports comma-separated values.

Available values:
- `NEW` - New business submissions
- `RENEWAL` - Renewal submissions
- `OTHER` - Other submission types

Examples:
- `?submission_type=NEW` - Matches new business submissions
- `?submission_type=NEW,RENEWAL` - Matches new or renewal submissions

params.name: effective_date_min
params.description:
Filter coverages by minimum effective date (inclusive). Use ISO 8601 date format.

Examples:
- `?effective_date_min=2024-01-01` - Matches coverages with effective date on or after January 1, 2024
- `?effective_date_min=2024-01-01&effective_date_max=2024-12-31` - Matches coverages with effective date in 2024

params.name: effective_date_max
params.description:
Filter coverages by maximum effective date (inclusive). Use ISO 8601 date format.

Examples:
- `?effective_date_max=2024-12-31` - Matches coverages with effective date on or before December 31, 2024
- `?effective_date_min=2024-01-01&effective_date_max=2024-12-31` - Matches coverages with effective date in 2024

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

items.docs:

- insured
- coverage_type
- agent (any assigned team member, not just primary)
- status
- submission_type
- effective_date_min (minimum effective date, inclusive)
- effective_date_max (maximum effective date, inclusive)
